To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the quadrupole moments of the ground states of pionic Ho and Ta are positive and that the quadrupolar splitting of the pionic Bi 4f levels is negative.
the quadrupole deformation of pionic atoms has been observed and the first quadrupole moments of pionic atoms have been measured.
we have measured the hyperfine splitting for pionic 4d levels of Ho, Yb, Er and Ta, and the hyperfine splitting of pionic 3f levels of Ta.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of hyperfine structure of nuclear X-rays from pion- and kaon-induced atoms.

the following topics: (1) Nuclear structure and hyperfine interactions of pionic and kaon atoms. (2) Nuclear quadrupole moments and deformation of nuclei. (3) Nuclear structure of pionic and hyperon atoms.
the study of the strong interaction in nuclear matter by means of the hyperfine interaction between nuclear moments and the electromagnetic field.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there are no significant deviations from the predictions of the optical-model calculations.
the quadrupole moment of the pionic 4d level in Ta is negative, that for the 4f level in Ta is positive and that for the 5d level in Ta it is zero.
, although the quadrupole moment of pionic 3p 3/2 Ho has been determined, the quadrupole moments of the other pionic levels have not been determined with sufficient accuracy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the optical-model calculation is not able to describe all the experimental data.
the quadrupole deformation is not a significant effect for the pionic levels in In, Ta and Bi but that the 4f levels of Yb and Ta are strongly deformed.
, in general, the data are consistent with the deformed optical model.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the strong interaction monopoles are not as large as predicted by the deformed optical-model calculations, but are consistent with the results of the non-relativistic optical model calculation by Koltun and Reitan.
we were able to show that the pionic and kaon X-ray data are consistent with each other and with the optical model.
the pionic 4p level in Ta is not a pure 4p level, but is a mixture of 4p and 5d levels.
